A Tibia Tale in the {wiki:Corym Mines|Corym Mines}, beneath the Venore Corym cave. The foreman {npc:Corym Ratter} wants to know why production is falling, but the workers are preparing a revolt: you forge a key, free the imprisoned coryms and gather {item:Rare Earth} for their weapons. You receive 2 {item:Gold Nugget|Gold Nuggets} and three small gems, but a surprise awaits you on the way out: the miniboss {creature:Cave Spider}.
The foreman of the Corym Mines wants you to find out what is behind the fall in his profits, but his workers have other plans...
Corym Ratter, at the entrance to the Corym Mines
You must be able to kill a creature at the level of a {creature:Giant Spider} on your own (the final teleport is individual).
optional, from the first worker in the northwest room
optional, from the first worker in the northeast room
optional, from the first worker in the southwest room
At the start of the quest: {npc:Corym Ratter} opens the mine for you ({key:help}, {key:yes}) and {npc:Corym Servant} gives you access to the floor below.
Part of the Corym Mines from the mission *The Curse Spreads* (Grimvale Quest)
You need access to the inside of the Corym Mines that this quest gives (you can start it right there).
Kill the {creature:Stonerefiner|Stonerefiners} on the way instead of running from them: you will need 20 {item:Rare Earth} that they drop.
You can leave the mine halfway through the quest without facing the Cave Spider: the exit teleport only takes you to the spider's room when the quest is finished.
Get to the Venore Corym Cave

The {wiki:Venore Corym Cave} is in the swamp **east** of Venore. Leave the city by the **east** entrance and follow the swamp to a building: go up the stairs of that building and then down the ladders to the cave. That way you do not need to use the rope.
Entrance building of the Venore Corym Cave

Go down to the deepest floor of the {wiki:Venore Corym Cave|Venore Corym Cave} and head to the **northwest** area. Walk along the **north** wall until you find a new passage with a teleport. Step into it: you are in the Corym Mines.
The cave has several kinds of {wiki:Corym|Coryms}.
Talk to the {npc:Corym Ratter}: {key:hi}, {key:help} and {key:yes}. He opens the mine for you.

Go through the {wiki:Sealed Door|Sealed Door} to the **east** and keep heading **north** to the {npc:Corym Servant}. Say {key:hi}, {key:decreasing resources} and {key:defy}. He wants you to free the imprisoned coryms and gives you access to the floor below.
Go down the stairs to the {creature:Stonerefiner|Stonerefiners} area. Go **northeast** and enter the fire room. Open the {wiki:Box (Quest)|box} to receive a {item:Metal File}.
Kill the Stonerefiners: you need 20 {item:Rare Earth} in the end.
The box with the Metal File, in the fire room
Pick up the head of the key
Go **south** and take the first passage on the **right**. In this room there is a box hidden behind an {wiki:Item Pile|item pile}. Open it to receive the {item:Rusted Key Fragment (Head)}.
Box with the Rusted Key Fragment (Head)
Pick up the handle of the key
Continue along the passage to the end and open the box to receive the {item:Rusted Key Fragment (Handle)}.
Box with the Rusted Key Fragment (Handle)
Second key fragment: the handle, at the end of the passage
Use the {item:Metal File} on each fragment. You get the {item:Polished Key Fragment (Head)} and the {item:Polished Key Fragment (Handle)}.
Go to the **big room** you passed through on the way to the first box and follow the sequence in the table, using the objects of the forge.
The objects to use to forge the Forged Key
{item:Steaming Hot Lava (Bottom)|Steaming Hot Lava} coming out of the Crucible

If you need to leave, **stop here** (or before). While the quest is not finished, the exit teleport takes you back to the Corym cave you came in by, without facing the Cave Spider. You can come back later to finish.
Go back up and walk through the mine until you have used the {item:Forged Key} on the **three** locked {wiki:Sealed Door|Sealed Doors}.
Use the Forged Key on the three doors
Enter each room and say {key:hi} to the first {npc:Corym Worker} you find. Each one gives you a gem.
Go back to the {npc:Corym Servant} and say {key:hi}. Now he wants **20** {item:Rare Earth} to make heat-resistant weapons.
Go down to the floor below and kill {creature:Stonerefiner|Stonerefiners} until you have **20** {item:Rare Earth}.
Hand in to the Corym Servant
Go back to the {npc:Corym Servant} and say {key:hi} and {key:yes}. You receive 2 {item:Gold Nugget|Gold Nuggets}. He warns that there are rumours of an unknown guardian.

Use the exit teleport of the mine. You end up in a separate room with **three** {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas} and the mini-boss {creature:Cave Spider}, which behaves like a {creature:Giant Spider}. Kill it and leave the room to officially finish the quest.
You enter the teleport **alone** and have **5 minutes** to kill the Cave Spider; if you fail, you are sent back to the mine. Bring potions and poison cure.
You have 5 minutes to kill the Cave Spider; otherwise you are sent back to the mine

After leaving the Cave Spider's room, go back up through the floors of the Venore Corym Cave, taking the same stairs and ladders you came down by, to the building in the swamp. From there return to Venore through the **east** entrance.
If you leave before finishing the quest, the mine's exit teleport drops you at the spot in the Corym cave where you came in.
The quest is part of the Tibia Tales and appears in that section of the Quest Log.
